title: 5 things we have learned so far from Broncos Camp

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 5 things we have learned so far from Broncos Camp
sources.description: Denver Broncos training camp is off and rolling, and the team has been on the practice field for two ramp-up practices and two official camp practices with fans in attendance. It’s still very early into the process, and the pads have not come on yet; that’s on Monday, but we have learned a few things […]
